text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Nanny seems quite eager. It has been a 
while since our whole family could gather 
to celebrate your birthday, dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that right? There's really no need 
to get so worked up over it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sister and Father and everyone else lead 
such busy lives, making opportunities like 
this so rare. It's only natural that so 
much feeling went into it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let us spend some quiet, private time 
together today, for the first time in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I simply wish to talk with you, dear 
sister. While reminiscing a little about 
the past.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a plain and simple invitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because I am the younger sister. Isn't 
that just how it goes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, perhaps I should go show my 
face to my fathers after so long.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, by all means. Both Father and Mother 
are very much looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of putting one's heart into it— 
Don't tell me... did you prepare a 
home-cooked meal for me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. No need to worry, Nanny is 
personally preparing things that dear 
sister prefers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Though enjoying something 
as light and fleeting as fresh powder snow 
wouldn't have been so bad once in a while.
